question: Can an onset-conditioned FiLM adapter learn a useful correction direction for the correctly loaded frozen r5b parent, after additive residual corrections failed?
hypothesis: Conditioning the parent's medium features on velocity, source parameters, and two true onset frames will be better aligned with future wavefield error than an additive future-field residual generated from the same sparse inputs.
pilot_success_conditions: best.pt exists and records the exact training sample and group IDs
the parent checkpoint hash recorded in best.pt matches the registered r5b checkpoint
promotion_rule: No validation access follows this training run. The checkpoint must first pass a separately preregistered, group-disjoint train-split gate comparing the parent, zero-shot adapter, and onset-only latent-refined adapter under one common metric.
